about_the_game:
The Art of EVERSPACE 2 - Ancients & Titans collects hundreds of images created to expand the universe of EVERSPACE 2 into a single digital artbook. Explore the creative visions behind the expanded space adventures ROCKFISH Games have crafted for EVERSPACE 2.

In this digital artbook, discover concept art, behind-the-scenes sketches, character work, cinematic captures, and more for space and sci-fi fans. Dive deep into the inspirations behind new enemies, environments, and ships found in EVERSPACE 2: Titans, and EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients!

Featuring more than 152 pages of concept art and more from Tobias Frank and the ROCKFISH Games art team, this artbook shows the craft that goes into one of the most popular independent space games of the last decade.

content_descriptors.notes: EVERSPACE 2 is a space shooter-looter game with a sci-fi storyline and mature themes. It contains language, mild blood, mild suggestive themes and violence suitables for 12+ ages and above.
